title: A Crow Keeps Saying My Name (Part 2) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Last time, a crow saved your life. Then it spoke in your dad's voice.
You open the window. Of course you do.
The crow hops onto your desk and shakes the rain off its feathers.
"You got tall," it says. Exactly like he used to say it.
You talk all night. About school. About Mum. About everything you never got to say.
It knows things only your dad knew. Your secret handshake. Your fear of ducks.
In the morning, it's still there. Eating toast. Laughing at your jokes.
For a week, you're the happiest you've been in years.
Then one morning, the crow is quiet.
"I have to go back," it says. "I can't stay as a bird."
"Then stay as something else," you beg. "Anything."
It looks at you for a long time.
"Okay," it says. "But you have to let me in. All the way."
You say yes before you think.
*The crow flies straight into your chest. And everything goes black.
You wake up on your fence. Small. Black. Feathers.
And through the window, you watch yourself eating toast. Smiling with your dad's smile.
Tell me in the comments, and follow for more stories from Creepyville.
